files.html:
Change Log 0.1.4

Added

  • Player party level matching — Added Match player party average mode, which sets trainer levels based on the player's current party average with an adjustable offset from -99 to 99.
  • Level gap preservation — Trainer parties keep their originally authored level differences where possible when level matching is applied.
  • Battle level scope — Fixed level rules can now affect only the trainer party or both sides of the battle.
  • DRM Trainer AI controls — Decision Quality, Battle Knowledge, Aggression, Defense, Trickery, and Switching can now be configured independently from 0–100.
  • Trainer AI presets — Added Beginner, Standard, Expert, and Boss presets. Any preset can be further customized after selection.
  • AI profile overview — Trainer AI settings now include descriptions for difficulty, information use, battle style, switching behavior, consistency, strengths, and warnings.
  • Trainer item-use controls — Added item-use presets with configurable priority, healing threshold, boost turn limit, Revive usage, status recovery, and PP recovery.
  • Large-list search and paging — Pokémon pickers, item catalogs, Clone Library, RCT imports, and presentation image lists now support search and pagination.
  • PokéMart list controls — Added server-side search and paging for products, trades, owned Pokémon, listings, selling choices, and claims.
  • Starter Selector dialogue action — DRM Dialogue can now open a specific Starter Selector JSON or the selector bound to the current NPC using go_starter_selector.
  • Clone overwrite confirmation — Clone Library now asks for confirmation before overwriting an existing Clone ID.

Changed

  • Safe battle-level overrides — Level matching and fixed-level rules now modify battle copies only and never change the player's actual Pokémon levels.
  • Trainer AI migration — Existing AI Skill, Temperament, and Knowledge values are automatically converted to equivalent settings in the new Trainer AI system.
  • Unified DRM interface — Cobblemon editor screens now use the DRM Core panel, topbar, button, field, card, and scrollbar styles.
  • Presentation image loading — Presentation thumbnails now load only when needed to reduce unnecessary resource usage.
  • Default GUI upgrade — Untouched PokéMart and Starter Selector GUIs automatically upgrade to the DRM sprite-based style while preserving customized GUI files.
  • Clone Library loading — Clone Library search and pagination are now handled server-side for better performance with large clone collections.

Fixed

  • Trainer AI fallback handling — Invalid AI decisions now fall back to a valid server action instead of causing the battle to stall.
